'''Lemon drizzle cake''' is a simple butter [[Cookbook:Cake|cake]] flavored with lemon zest and juice, and topped with a lemony [[Cookbook:Frosting and Icing|icing]].
==Ingredients==

=== Cake ===
*280 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (9.9 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]/2¼ sticks) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], plus extra for greasing
*280 g (9.9 oz/1¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]]) [[Cookbook:Superfine Sugar|superfine sugar]]
*5 standard [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*[[Cookbook:Zest|Zest]] and juice of 1 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]]
*300 g (11 oz/2¼ cups) [[Cookbook:Self-rising Flour|self-raising flour]]
*1½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
===Icing===

* 150 g (5.3 oz/1¼ cups) [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|powdered sugar]]
* Juice of ½ lemon

==Procedure==
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to {{Convert|190|C|F}}. Grease and line a {{Convert|20|cm|in|abbr=on|adj=on}} square [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake tin]].
#[[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] the butter and sugar in a mixing bowl, until soft and fluffy.
#Beat in the eggs, one at a time, then lemon juice and zest.
#[[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] the flour and baking powder into the mixture.
#Spoon the mixture into the cake tin.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 25 minutes until a [[Cookbook:Skewer|skewer]] inserted into the center comes out clean.
#Transfer the cake to a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|wire rack]] and leave it to cool.
#Mix the icing sugar and lemon juice in a bowl until it is thick enough to coat the back of spoon.
#Drizzle the icing over the cake.
#Enjoy!
